name: Health and fitness log
description: Checks the numbers you keep about training, food, appointments and measurements. Plan check finds weekly volume, rest days, long streaks and week-on-week jumps above 10%; Meal totals adds the diary numbers you wrote; Appointments lists upcoming and overdue; Trend shows first, last, change and recent average of each measure. NOT medical advice and it never diagnoses: it is arithmetic on your own numbers. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Training plan check
presets.description: Weekly volume (minutes, distance, load ...: name the column with metric=, or it is found), sessions, training and rest days, the longest run of training days, and rises above the threshold (extra arguments threshold=10 min_rest=1 max_streak=6). The 10% figure is a rule of thumb, not a safe limit.

presets.label: Meal diary totals
presets.description: Daily and per-meal totals of kcal, protein, carbs and fat from the numbers YOU wrote in the diary (date, meal, item, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g); notes items with no kcal and labels whose numbers do not agree. Extra argument target=2000 shows each day against a target you chose. No food is looked up.

presets.label: Appointments: upcoming and overdue
presets.description: From a list (date, time, title, who, done): overdue (past and not marked done), coming up within N days, later, and clashes on the same date and time. Extra arguments: today=YYYY-MM-DD within=30.

presets.label: Weight and measure trend
presets.description: For every numeric column (weight, waist, resting pulse ...): readings, first, last, change, percent, change per 30 days, lowest, highest, average of the last three, direction of the last three. A change says nothing by itself about health.
